literal_source_claim: Primary inventory gloss: probabilistically checkable proofs. Corroborating repository inventory shorthand: NP = PCP[O(log n), O(1)].
canonical_claim: Over binary strings, verifier-based NP equals the class recognized by polynomial-time nonadaptive binary proof-oracle checkers using O(log n) random bits, O(1) queries, perfect completeness, and soundness one half.

excluded_degenerate_cases: Not frozen.
